results.title: Unleaded 95
results.overview: Aino is celebrating her bachelorette party. Toni, who was once briefly with Aino, works at the gas station. Lolly has moved away, but always has sex with Aino's mother whenever she returns to her hometown.

results.title: Feliz Suicidio
results.overview: Diego, a young man with addiction problems, considers ending his life, but his great fear of dying prevents him from doing so—until he sees a television advertisement for "Happy Suicide," a service that organizes suicides for couples. When he arrives at the location, Diego meets his partner, Saúl, a good-natured clown; both are eager to end their lives. What they don't expect is to find that they have only been given one bullet, so they begin to debate who deserves to die more.

results.title: Killing Jar
results.overview: After her mother's death, an entomologist struggles to process her grief while working.

results.title: The Baronesse
results.overview: The young baroness of Castle Rhede leads the quite ordinary life of a noblewoman. Her maid tends to her beauty with all sorts of poisonous cosmetics, and her mother ensures that she keeps her tiny waistline by serving very spartan meals. But one day, to her great horror, she finds herself trapped in a horrific situation. A very deep male voice, which apparently only she can hear, starts to dictate the fate of the castle—and predicts a grim end for the baroness.

results.title: Tough Love
results.overview: After accidentally killing one of her clients, a recently divorced housewife turned dominatrix must figure out what to do next - all while dealing with her manipulative teenage son.

results.title: No Man Is an Island
results.overview: A short verbatim documentary that tells the story of how the Isle of Man came to decriminalise homosexual acts in 1992. The film follows the parliamentary debates around changing the law, the febrile atmosphere on the island as activists protested at Tynwald Day, the 1991 general election campaign where gay sex seemed to be on the ballot, and the police raids of public toilets where gay men would meet. The film specially explores ideas around social shame and the media as an extra-judicial mechanism for social control in small communities.

results.title: Lawless
results.overview: Nico is a widowed ex-cop and the father of a teenage girl. After the death of his wife, he is fired from the force and dedicates himself to training boxers for underground fights. But when Sol is kidnapped by a mob, the most desperate search of his life begins.

results.title: Danny Is My Boyfriend
results.overview: After discovering they’re dating the same man, a recovering codependent living with her mother and a socially awkward babysitter fumble their way through a series of misguided schemes, enlisting a parade of eccentric and unqualified accomplices in a half-baked mission to get revenge.

results.title: Yú Cì (Fish Bones)
results.overview: Bowen, a nonbinary Asian-American from Queens, tries to connect with their estranged father and help him deal with a poisonous fish bite.

results.title: Brent Forever: Live From Brooklyn Paramount
results.original_title: Brent Forever: Live From Brooklyn Paramount
results.overview: Chelsea Cutler & Jeremy Zucker perform songs from their three 'Brent' Projects live from Brooklyn Paramount.  Performed Live on November 26, 2024.

results.title: Eric Jerome Dickey's Friends and Lovers Part I
results.original_title: Eric Jerome Dickey's Friends and Lovers Part I
results.overview: Four friends' lives become intertwined when romance blooms between a doctor and a comedian, while his best friend falls for her free-spirited bestie. After a tragic event, their relationships evolve into something deeper than friendship.

results.title: August
results.overview: The history of the military operation "Bagration", which took place in August 1944.

results.title: Words From Home
results.overview: WORDS FROM HOME is a poetic documentary that explores the kinds of affection and identity in the portuguese language spoken in Brazil. Through migrants' stories and their reflections, the movie reveals how expressions, accents and memories form emotional and cultural bonds, showing how speaking connects us, differentiates us and, above all, brings us closer together.

results.title: Le Paillasson
results.overview: The film explores the lives of Alessandro, his friend Cléry and his grandmother, who all struggle with the passage of time and the choices they make. As Alessandro repeatedly undoes his successes and loses in the metaphorical game of life, the story highlights the consequences of wasted time and the ongoing struggle against personal failure.

results.title: Turtle Sandwich
results.overview: Ten year old Ethan runs 86th street. Featuring Mr Dino, Mr Goon, and 9 year olds, Wilten and Oliver.

results.title: James - Live at the Acropolis
results.overview: Live at the Acropolis captures the band’s unforgettable live performance at the historic Odeon of Herodes Atticus, an open-air amphitheater beneath the Acropolis in Athens. Recorded on the 10th of July, 2023, this album transports listeners to that magical night, where James along with along with a 22 piece orchestra conducted by Joe Duddell and an 8 piece choir, delivered a powerful set against the backdrop of ancient history.

results.title: Ginger Root's SHINBANGUMI: A Music Movie
results.original_title: Ginger Root's SHINBANGUMI: A Music Movie
results.overview: After being fired from media conglomerate, Juban TV, due to creative differences, Cameron takes it upon himself to start his own TV company, Ginger Root Productions.

results.title: Aşk mı Para mı?
results.overview: Despite all the obstacles between them, Alya and Sinan fall deeply in love. However, Alya's pregnancy becomes a tragic turning point due to the interference of Sinan's powerful and ruthless father, Haldun. On one hand, the intrigues of their enemies Mehmet and Melisa, who want to seize their company, and on the other hand, long-hidden family secrets, turn the couple's lives upside down. As the dark truths of the past are revealed, Alya and Sinan will have to fight to protect both their love and their future.
